stem: What happens next in this passage after “The restorer explained that dirt and yellowed varnish were not the artist's original plan.”?
options: The goal was to get closer to what the painting once looked like, not to make it new.
The animals looked strange: some were transparent, some glowed, and some had shapes like nothing on land.
The new version looked clear, but the family kept the damaged original too.
Historians worried the lights would make the bridge look like an amusement ride.
